title: ROWING, CREW I (MEN/WOMEN): ROWING, CREW I/ MEN
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 11 credits
description: Introduction to the sport of rowing; designed for the novice (beginner). Includes basic technique and terminology, related water safety, and development of strength, endurance, and flexibility.
clssnotes:
Mandatory Day 1 meeting: Wednesday, September 23 at Reser Stadium Club Level. Subsequent classes at Rowing Center. Class directed towards trying out for varsity rowing. Contact Michael Eichler for more questions: Michael.Eichler@oregonstate.edu
